4222-5268-8299.description:
Activate Hemmer by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hemmer triggers, causing you to loot
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Hemmer.
Repeat.

5170-5686-6132-8292.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

1286-6888-8095.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-2921-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2921-3125-7396.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

4364-5147-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-5147-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4-1170-1636-7517.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Aqueous Aria using convoke without paying mana.
4-1170-1636-7517.description:
Cast Aqueous Aria using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Campus Composer.
When Campus Composer enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

944-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Planar Gate.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
944-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

789-1263-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3000-5670-7399.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
3000-5670-7399.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-4050-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

3220-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6798-7286.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1734-2150-5686.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

645-1267-5256-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5256-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

2697-3976-6852.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2697-3976-6852.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Discontinuity and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Last Chance and Discontinuity noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Discontinuity without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4073--6.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature, adding {B}.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing a +1/+1 counter from the undying creature, giving any creature -1/-1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2724-2963-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

1322-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
1322-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3698-4742-5687.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5402.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-5402.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2059-2857-5253.notablePrerequisites:
Brion Stoutarm and Adarkar Valkyrie do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {R}.
2059-2857-5253.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Activate Brion Stoutarm by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Village Bell-Ringer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Brion Stoutarm ability from step 3, dealing damage equal to Village Bell-Ringer's power to an opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

230-1912-3002-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-1912-3002-4050.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1308-2733-2832-4050.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting Brine Comber.
Brine Comber triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings' second ability by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

238-2506-5256.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-2506-5256.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your graveyard or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Gerrard with haste.
Put the nontoken Gerrard into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The nontoken Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the token Gerrard.
The token Gerrard dies, exiling itself and returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill infinite cards.

1734-2034-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {C}{C}.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Repeat.

3201-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Arixmethes does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes has no slumber counters on it.
Freed from the Real attached to Arixmethes.
3201-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real, untapping Arixmethes.
Repeat.

618-4681-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
